rationale: All medical, build, lipid, A1c, tobacco, family, occupation and financial factors carry zero debits; face plus in-force is well within 25x income. Three moving violations in the last three years take 50 debits under section 11, placing the file in Table 2. The DUI table does not apply. Nearest precedents all have clean driving records and do not bear on this debit, so rated on the manual table.
